scripts.build: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && tsc -b --pretty false && vite build --config apps/author-web/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/admin-web/vite.config.ts
scripts.dev:author: vite --config apps/author-web/vite.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 43280 --strictPort
scripts.dev:api: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/backend apps/api && node apps/api/dist/main.js
scripts.dev:worker: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/backend apps/worker && node apps/worker/dist/main.js
scripts.test:author: vitest run --config apps/author-web/vite.config.ts apps/author-web/src
scripts.test:pg: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/backend apps/worker && vitest run tests/postgres
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && tsc -b --pretty false && vitest run tests/unit && vitest run --config apps/author-web/vite.config.ts apps/author-web/src && vite build --config apps/author-web/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/admin-web/vite.config.ts
